hook_line: BHARAT SEMI RAISES $24 MILLION TO BUILD AI IMAGE SENSORS IN INDIA

hook_stat.sub: Seed round raised by Bharat Semi, a New Delhi semiconductor startup

news_summary: Bharat Semi, a New Delhi semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in an all-equity seed round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures.
payoff: Its sensors are still under development, with production targeted for 2027.
